# Baby name shortlist

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/baby-names/

Browse a curated list of names and save a personal shortlist. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Filter a starter list by its first letter, add your own names and export your favorites.

## Limits and checks

The starter list is a small collection, not a ranking of popularity or an authoritative source for name origins or meanings.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
